QuestInfo.name: The Workings of Neinheart's Heart
QuestInfo.0: Kiku has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1:
Kiku says Neinheart wants you to return to Ereve. Sigh. Better go see what he wants. 

#bTip: Either get on the boat for Ereve from the Victoria Tree Platform located above the Six Path Crossway or use the skill Imperial Recall.#k
QuestInfo.2: Kiku says Neinheart wants you to return to Ereve. You talked to him and learned his reasons for serving the Empress. What a complicated guy.

0.0: Hey, I think Neinheart's lookin' for you. Better speed it up and get over there. Even the Black Mage wouldn't want to deal with Neinheart on a bad day.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m130000000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I said Neinheart is looking for you! What part of HURRY UP did you not get?

1.0: It has been some time since the day we first met, hasn't it? You left your home and placed your trust in strangers. You are a brave young warrior.
1.1: I don't believe I've explained properly, but Maple World was once under the rule of the Black Mage. Five heroes appeared and stopped his tyrannical reign, but at a high cost. Empress Aria lost her life.
1.2: Lady Cygnus cannot share the same fate. That is why I formed the knights and that is why I do everything that I do. I'm telling you this because I believe you feel the same. We are on the same side, as we will always be, and I am certain that you are ready to stand at my side. Take some time and think about it, but be quick.
